title: Polynomial identity testing verifier
statement: Given Boolean lists $x$ and $r$, decode the two components of the pair encoded by $x$. The verifier returns false exactly when both decode as well-formed algebraic circuits over the same number of variables and the difference of their outputs evaluates to zero on $r$; in every other case it returns true.
